items.name: Lantern Glass
items.lore: Won from the Lantern on the Water. A bead of the Glimmer's light, gone dark.

items.name: Silver Horseshoe
items.lore: One of the Earl's horse's shoes, worn as thin as a leaf, on a chain.

items.name: Earl's Signet
items.lore: Gearoid Iarla's own ring. He dropped it turning back into the lake.

items.name: Grieving Knight's Tear
items.lore: A fairy knight's tear, frozen. It's still sad.

items.name: Signal-Fire Brooch
items.lore: From the Sentinels' road post on the deamhan moor.

items.name: Ultan's Azure Seal
items.lore: Brother-Captain Ultan's seal ring, the crown crossed out.
